question: A bus covers a distance of 30 km in 45 minutes and further it covers double the distance covered earlier in 60 minutes. The average speed of the bus is _________ km/hr (rounded off to two decimal places).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 30 km + (2 × 30 km) = 90 km.

Total time in hours = (45 + 60) ÷ 60 = 105 / 60 = 7/4 hours.

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time = 90 ÷ (7/4) = (90 × 4) / 7.

Average speed = 360 / 7 = 51.428... ≈ 51.43 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 51.43 km/hr.**
